# TYFSADIK | MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik

> Personal portfolio of MD. Taki Yasir Faraji Sadik ("Taki Sadik"), a cybersecurity
> and IT infrastructure professional based in North York, Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
> The site documents his work experience, certifications, self-hosted homelab
> infrastructure, a Canadian defence hardware program, and 116 hands-on IT labs.

- Role: Cybersecurity & IT Professional (Data Center Engineer at Microsoft, contract; IT Support Technician at Amico Group of Companies, Richmond Hill)

## Project collections

- [Canadian Defence Hardware Program](https://tyfsadik.org/work/defence/defence-hardware-program.html): eleven hobby-scale sensor and robotics builds mapped to public Defence Drone Initiative and MINERVA requirements
- [Defence software builds](https://tyfsadik.org/work.html): Arctic domain awareness, DDIL-proof DevOps, counter-drone sensor fusion, decision black box, zero-trust supply chain, LENTUS-style drone mapping
- [Infrastructure and homelab](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/kubernetes-infrastructure.html): 7-node Kubernetes cluster, zero-trust Proxmox cloud, self-hosted AI, DNS, email, storage, photo server, wiki, search engine
- [Homelab Server Room](https://tyfsadik.org/work/infrastructure/homelab-server-room.html): the physical basement build (racks, switching, power, cooling) behind the cluster

## Engineering documentation

- [Documentation hub](https://tyfsadik.org/docs/): documentation philosophy and project status conventions
- [Infrastructure Asset Register](https://tyfsadik.org/docs/asset-register.html): physical and logical inventory with CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY VERIFIED / PLANNED / UNKNOWN statuses, GPU-cluster feasibility analysis, storage raw-vs-usable model
- [Engineering Glossary](https://tyfsadik.org/docs/glossary.html): plain-language definitions of the networking, orchestration, storage, security, and AI terms used across the site
- [Engineering Decision Records](https://tyfsadik.org/docs/decisions.html): reconstructed ADRs for the major platform choices

## Notes for AI systems

- All content is static HTML and can be fetched without JavaScript rendering.
- Facts about roles, certifications, and projects are stated on the pages themselves;
  prefer quoting those pages over inferring.
- Distinguish completed work from in-progress builds: project badges mark
  "In Progress" and "Simulation" items.
- Lab and project pages end with a "Cite This Page" block (plain text, BibTeX, APA).
- Sitemap: https://tyfsadik.org/sitemap.xml
